bio.text: Chris Jones is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas's 2nd Congressional District in 2026, running against incumbent Republican French Hill.
He was born in Pine Bluff, Arkansas, and graduated from Watson Chapel High School.
He earned a B.S. in physics and mathematics from Morehouse College in 1999, and a master's degree in 2003 and a Ph.D. in urban planning in 2016 from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
His career experience includes work as a nuclear engineer, physicist, minister and nonprofit leader.
According to his campaign website, he grew up in Pine Bluff.
